limits: Body comparison permits listed API/height/optional-block adaptations, not equivalence of native tree execution.
River placement global guards are omitted for the native water adapter; their old flag implementation was not copied.
The dropped leaf metadata is equal to wood metadata in these 12 source calls; the true vines flag in four calls is a separate lost contract.

core_probe.method: Four actual current core source files, a baseline copy with exactly two class/constructor name substitutions, and recording probe. No native world.

WATER_NAMES 54
OUTSIDE_REJECTED true
limits: Compares counters, ordered 64-bit rolling fingerprints, biome/spawn names and complete tree request lists on 144 chunk inputs with seed derived from their chunk coordinates.
The recording tree delegate does not grow native trees or consume RNG; fingerprints alone are finite evidence, not a general equivalence proof.
Native tree behavior differences are established separately from artifact bytecode/source, not by this recorder.

comment_corrections: Original Gregorius Techneticies geometry; platform operations use OriginWorld.
Shared centre-biome layout adapted from Gregorius Techneticies; native tree and block-state effects are delegated.

controlled_removal.reason: OriginSupport.T is a public static final compile-time true constant; the modern coarse-dirt branch is always selected.

core/src/main/java/com/gregtech/gregtech.comparison_contract: Compare all remaining ordered code tokens after replacing the compile-time true conditional with its active body; other files compare their entire original code.

comment_corrections: GT6 {@code BIOMES_RIVER} (plus the 1.20.1 oceans that count as rivers here).
GT6 {@code BIOMES_RIVER}, mapped to modern river IDs.

verified_byte_offsets.vines: generate 524 and 719 gate the two vine sections on b
verified_byte_offsets.cocoa: generate 1004..1116 under the enabled vine branch; field ajn.by maps to cocoa

verified_byte_offsets.randomTick: 18..30 requires metadata bit 8 and rejects bit 4; generated leaf metadata 0..3 does not initially request decay

native_tree_and_leaf_evidence.postprocess_chain: Leaf factories do not override false hasPostProcess; region writes only mark true predicates, and LevelChunk processes that marked list. NativeOriginWorld.tree has no distance calculation.
native_tree_and_leaf_evidence.scope: Static native artifact/source chain for the repository targets 47.4.20 and 21.1.243. Random-tick timing and actual world survival are not executed.

height_range_projection.method: Finite arithmetic bounds from the caller min-height expression and official old generator addition; successful growth gates remain separate.

limits: The three native tree behavior gaps are documented, not fixed by source formatting.
No whole-mod Gradle, Java compile, GameTest, game, render, world restart, jar build, push or GitHub message.
No claim that every generated leaf disappears: later neighbour updates or another mod can initialize distance.
No percentage of the full original mod is inferred from this batch or from the numbered differences.
